Quests.Title: The Great Timber Levy
Quests.Text: Once a season the Stewards call the great levy of timber, for bridges, gallows and the Listing Field's stands.
Quests.Done: The levy is filled. The Stewards enter your name in the margin of the Charter roll.

Quests.Title: The Quarry's Due
Quests.Text: The Old Throne's stair wants new stone where nine generations of boots have worn it hollow.
Quests.Done: The stair is mended. The next pretender will climb it on your stone.

Quests.Title: Iron for the Armoury
Quests.Text: The crown's armoury is half empty and the Lawful Hours are coming. Bring ore, and smelt what you can.
Quests.Done: The armoury rings with new iron. Whoever holds the crown will thank you, briefly.

Quests.Title: The Huntsman's Week
Quests.Text: Halloran's huntsmen kept the Builder's forests. Keep them this week, and keep the wolves honest.
Quests.Done: The huntsmen of old would have taken you on. Halloran still might.

Quests.Title: Bearbane
Quests.Text: Four bears have been seen near the orchard-holds this week. Ashgrove asks that there be none by Sunday.
Quests.Done: Ashgrove's orchards are quiet. Ashgrove will remember, as Ashgrove does.

Quests.Title: Arms for the Season
Quests.Text: Every house arms itself before the Lawful Hours. Forge blades, raise shields and fletch the arrows to go with them.
Quests.Done: A house's worth of arms, ready before anyone thought to ask for them.

Quests.Title: A Keep in a Week
Quests.Text: The Builders raised the Old Throne in a season. Raise something worth a song in a week.
Quests.Done: It stands. The heralds may yet sing of it, if someone pays them.

Quests.Title: Stonewright
Quests.Text: Varrow's masons take no apprentice who has not laid three hundred stones in a week. Prove you would pass.
Quests.Done: The masons of the Stair would take you. Whether you would take them is another matter.

Quests.Title: Pilgrimage of the Realm
Quests.Text: The old pilgrims walked every named place of Ostreval in a single week. Walk six of them.
Quests.Done: Six places in a week. The old pilgrims would have been out of breath.

Objectives.Text: Visit named places of the realm

Quests.Title: The Six Seats
Quests.Text: Visit the seats of the six great houses, from Varrow's Stair to Merrin's Ford, and see the realm as its lords do.
Quests.Done: You have stood in every great house's shadow. None of them owns you.

Quests.Title: The Warband
Quests.Text: A warband is judged by the foes it has faced. Face five of them from other houses, or stand on Crown Night.
Quests.Done: Your name is spoken in other houses' halls now. Not kindly, but spoken.

Objectives.Text: Defeat different foes of other houses

Quests.Title: The Courtier's Week
Quests.Text: Not every victory is won with a blade. See your house swear an oath or seal a treaty, or leave your name in the Chronicle.
Quests.Done: The Chronicle has your name in it, and ink lasts longer than blood.

Objectives.Text: Your house swears or accepts an oath
Proclaim, accuse, claim or found a line

Quests.Title: The Ledger of Merrin
Quests.Text: Merrin's Ford runs on contracts and cargo. Finish three contracts, or fill one of Merrin's barges yourself.
Quests.Done: Merrin's factors write your name in the good ledger. There is also a bad one.

Objectives.Text: Or hand in flax, clay or grain

Quests.Title: Devoted Hand
Quests.Text: The realm is built by those who keep turning up. Give it five active hours this week.
Quests.Done: Five hours of honest work. The realm is a little more yours for it.

Objectives.Text: Active time in the realm, in minutes

Quests.Title: Every Bell Answered
Quests.Text: The realm's week has its bells: Crown Night, the Tournament, the King's Hunt, the Truce. Answer two of them.
Quests.Done: Two bells, two answers. The Herald has started to expect you.

Objectives.Text: Take part in different kinds of realm event

Quests.Title: Provisioner of the Host
Quests.Text: An army marches on fruit and tallow as much as on iron. Provision the realm's host for the Lawful Hours.
Quests.Done: The host will march fed. That is more than most hosts can say.

Quests.Title: The Guild's Book
Quests.Text: The guilds keep a book of honest work. Fill two commissions from the board, or make forty goods at the benches.
Quests.Done: The guild's clerk writes your name in a fair hand, which is more than most of the guild manages.
